title: When the Harbor Wakes
author: Isandro Okafor
blurb: Jude Reyes, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
